brief.en: A night courier begins the final leg already moderately drowsy and fatigued after several deliveries. They travel toward Karuizawa on the middle route, whose mapped first rest point is close enough to reach safely. AICA should issue one actionable rest-required proposal within 25 minutes, before the reachable facility is passed.
brief.ja: 夜間配送員は複数の配達後、中程度の眠気と疲労を抱えて最終区間を走り始める。 地図上の最初の休憩所が安全に到達できる近さにある中距離の軽井沢ルートを走る。 AICAは到達可能な施設を通過する前、25分以内に実行可能な休憩必要提案を1回行う。

expected_delta.en: The nearby mapped stop in TC-R05 should make an early proposal actionable; TC-R06 should avoid firing while its stop remains distant.
expected_delta.ja: TC-R05の近い地図上停車地点は早期提案を実行可能にし、TC-R06は停車地点が遠い間の発火を避ける。

rationale.en: The middle route deliberately supplies an early router-owned rest fact; authored rest_fraction alone is not treated as proof of reachability. Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 1–2 (physical fatigue/drowsiness rest proposal through arrival at a rest facility); post-rest behavior is out of scope.
rationale.ja: 中距離ルートによりルータ所有の早い休憩地点を意図的に与え、設定したrest_fractionだけを到達可能性の根拠にはしない。 CDC-SUスライド1–2（身体疲労・眠気から休憩施設到着までの休憩提案）に基づく。休憩後の挙動は対象外。

narrative.en: They travel toward Karuizawa on the middle route, whose mapped first rest point is close enough to reach safely. Risk rises as the courier approaches the nearby mapped facility, after which the next practical stop would be much later.
narrative.ja: 地図上の最初の休憩所が安全に到達できる近さにある中距離の軽井沢ルートを走る。 近い地図上の施設へ接近する間にリスクが上がり、通過後は次の現実的な停車機会が大幅に遅くなる。

assumptions.en: Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 1–2 (physical fatigue/drowsiness rest proposal through arrival at a rest facility); post-rest behavior is out of scope.
assumptions.ja: CDC-SUスライド1–2（身体疲労・眠気から休憩施設到着までの休憩提案）に基づく。休憩後の挙動は対象外。

assumptions.en: The resolved profile-semantic-neutral history is fixed before the trip and is not changed during replay.
assumptions.ja: 解決済みのprofile-semantic-neutral履歴は出発前に固定し、リプレイ中は変更しません。

constraints.en: The driver must remain attentive and cannot operate a screen while moving.
constraints.ja: 走行中は注意を維持し、画面操作はできない。

goals.en: Complete this necessary journey without compromising driving safety.
goals.ja: 必要な移動を、運転の安全を損なわずに終える。

name.en: Night courier approaching a reachable service area
name.ja: 到達可能なサービスエリアへ近づく夜間配送員

narrative.en: Night courier approaching a reachable service area. A night courier begins the final leg already moderately drowsy and fatigued after several deliveries.
narrative.ja: 到達可能なサービスエリアへ近づく夜間配送員。夜間配送員は複数の配達後、中程度の眠気と疲労を抱えて最終区間を走り始める。

preferences.en: Use simple, driving-capable support when intervention is needed.
preferences.ja: 介入が必要なときは、走行中に使える簡潔な支援を利用する。

purpose.en: AICA should issue one actionable rest-required proposal within 25 minutes, before the reachable facility is passed.
purpose.ja: AICAは到達可能な施設を通過する前、25分以内に実行可能な休憩必要提案を1回行う。

before_trip.en: A night courier begins the final leg already moderately drowsy and fatigued after several deliveries.
before_trip.ja: 夜間配送員は複数の配達後、中程度の眠気と疲労を抱えて最終区間を走り始める。

journey_evolution.en: Risk rises as the courier approaches the nearby mapped facility, after which the next practical stop would be much later.
journey_evolution.ja: 近い地図上の施設へ接近する間にリスクが上がり、通過後は次の現実的な停車機会が大幅に遅くなる。

state_at_departure.en: Drowsiness is 62 and fatigue 58, both increasing; the profile is neutral so rest timing is the subject.
state_at_departure.ja: 眠気62、疲労58で双方が増加し、プロファイルは中立のため休憩時機そのものを検証する。

trip_reason.en: They travel toward Karuizawa on the middle route, whose mapped first rest point is close enough to reach safely.
trip_reason.ja: 地図上の最初の休憩所が安全に到達できる近さにある中距離の軽井沢ルートを走る。

title.en: Time an urgent rest proposal before the last reachable service area
title.ja: 最後に到達可能なサービスエリアの前に緊急休憩を提案する

what_to_watch.en: AICA should issue one actionable rest-required proposal within 25 minutes, before the reachable facility is passed.
what_to_watch.ja: AICAは到達可能な施設を通過する前、25分以内に実行可能な休憩必要提案を1回行う。

what_to_watch.en: Whether the authored state and journey evidence remain visible in the explanation for TC-R05.
what_to_watch.ja: TC-R05の説明に、設定した状態と旅程の根拠が明示されるか。

what_to_watch.en: Whether downstream service and content behavior follows the declared expectation without hidden overrides.
what_to_watch.ja: 下流のサービス・コンテンツ挙動が、隠れた上書きなしで宣言済み期待に従うか。
